The first option is to use a workaround like Binance P2P or local payment gateways, which can lead to delayed payments, high fees, and limited flexibility. The second option is to invest in a custom-built e-commerce solution, which can be expensive and time-consuming to set up. However, there's a third option that's gaining popularity among digital creators: building a sovereign digital commerce stack using Cloudflare infrastructure and NOWPayments. This approach offers a secure, automated, and decentralized way to sell digital products without relying on traditional payment processors.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Traditional payment processors like Stripe and Gumroad have strict policies against serving certain countries, including Pakistan. This means that even if you're based in the US or Europe, you can still face restrictions on your ability to sell digital products to customers in Pakistan. In contrast, a sovereign digital commerce stack built on Cloudflare infrastructure and NOWPayments doesn't rely on these traditional payment processors, so it's not subject to the same restrictions. This means you can sell digital products to customers in Pakistan without worrying about platform restrictions or penalties.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, a sovereign digital commerce stack using NOWPayments can settle transactions in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. In contrast, traditional payment processors like Stripe and Gumroad can take several days to process payments, and their fees can range from 2.9% + $0.30 to 3.5% + $0.30 per transaction. Additionally, a sovereign digital commerce stack allows you to keep your transaction data and customer information on your own servers, so you don't have to worry about sharing sensitive data with third-party payment processors.

Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

A sovereign digital commerce stack built on Cloudflare infrastructure and NOWPayments offers complete ownership and control over your digital products and customer data. This means you can automate delivery and customer communication using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, so you can focus on creating more content and engaging with your customers. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you're not limited by the features and restrictions of traditional payment processors, so you can build a more scalable and customizable e-commerce solution that meets your specific needs.
